page_title: HEI 4-2 WER | Heidenheim v Werder Bremen 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Patrick Ittrich is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Yellow card. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90+4' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) was too forceful with his tackle and Patrick Ittrich interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

90+3' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
90+2' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) meets a cross inside the box, but Kevin Muller wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Tim Kleindienst.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
88' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Shots on target – 4:3.
86' Werder Bremen show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
84' Here comes a substitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Christian Gross.
82' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Pick (Heidenheim) replacing Jan-Niklas Beste.
82' Substitution. Eren Dinkci walks off the pitch and Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
81' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.

80' Heidenheim slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
76' 4 - 2 Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
75' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) unleashed a promising volley from the edge of the box, but he narrowly misses the target as his shot goes over the bar.
73' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Marvin Pieringer and he is replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
73' It will be a substitution. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Norman Theuerkauf walks off.

73' Ooh that was close! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
71' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Jiri Pavlenka is prepared and dives to thwart him.

68' 3 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Jan-Niklas Beste, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim), who beats Jiri Pavlenka with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
65' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nick Woltemade walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen).
64' 2 - 2 Goal! Olivier Deman gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the top left corner. 2:2.
62' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

62' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
62' Heidenheim will take a corner kick.

62' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) received an accurate pass just outside the penalty area and produced a quick strike. It would have probably ended behind the goalkeeper, but one of the defenders managed to deflect it onto the post. The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
61' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Now Heidenheim have a corner.
60' The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.

60' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
58' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

55' A dangerous towering header by Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
55' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner.

53' A lofted cross from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. Heidenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Traore (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Patrick Ittrich didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' 2 - 1 Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
49' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fails to score from the penalty!
49' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is going to take the penalty!
48' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area. Werder Bremen are about to take a penalty!
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ole Werner gives a chance to Milos Veljkovic and Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) is replaced by Olivier Deman.
46' Ole Werner has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marvin Ducksch comes on the pitch for Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Heidenheim keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' 2 - 0 Goal! Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Jiri Pavlenka had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.

40' Big chance! A simple pass from Romano Schmid left Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
38' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
35' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' The corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is intercepted by Jiri Pavlenka.

32' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.

30' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
29' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
28' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
27' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) fails to score from close range. He picks up a rebound, but sends it wide of the target! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Werder Bremen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down. Patrick Ittrich has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Werder Bremen.
23' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
21' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
19' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
18' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is cleared to safety by the defence.
16' Werder Bremen keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
13' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Muller comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
6' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jiri Pavlenka to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
5' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
5' It’s a PENALTY to Heidenheim after the VAR review!
5' Referee Patrick Ittrich makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
5' Surely that's handball by one of the Werder Bremen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
3' One of the Werder Bremen players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Heidenheim have been awarded a free kick.
1' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will officiate today.
